$comment: Each entry is one behaviour of the chat pipeline, stated as the mutation that removes it from the current tree, the scenario that exercises it, and the oracle (apps/api/src/tests/helpers/chat-oracles.ts) that must fail when it is gone. Run: bun apps/api/scripts/chat-mutation-matrix.ts. An entry whose mutation no longer applies fails until it is replaced or retired with a reason.
